# CBT Cards

CBT Cards is a mobile app for general wellness and self-reflection. It includes short CBT-inspired cards, guided tools, a structured journal, and mood, stress, and energy check-ins. It is not medical advice, diagnosis, treatment, emergency support, or a substitute for professional care.

## Website locale status

- Website locale registry: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/locales.json
- Current published website locale: English (`en`) at the root URL.
- The website locale registry describes cbt-cards.github.io only.
- Do not infer Android or iOS language support from website locale metadata.
- A future second website locale requires stable locale URLs, reciprocal hreflang, synchronized discovery, and human review for health-adjacent translations.

## Learning and worksheets

- Learning library: https://cbt-cards.github.io/learn/
- Worksheet hub: https://cbt-cards.github.io/worksheets/
- Worksheet definitions: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/worksheets.json
- Public worksheet pages have no submit action; typed text remains in the current browser page unless the user independently prints or saves it.

## Public toolkit corpus

- Toolkit: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/
- Review-status page: https://cbt-cards.github.io/toolkit/review-status/
- Review overlay: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-review.json
- Toolkit source metadata: https://cbt-cards.github.io/data/toolkit-source.json
- Unlisted source records default to unreviewed and source-only.
- reviewed_for_publication means editorial/safety review for website publication, not clinical validation or proof of efficacy.

- Agent guide: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/

- Skill manifest: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/manifest.json
- Immutable skill v1.6.0: https://cbt-cards.github.io/agents/cbt-cards/v1.6.0/SKILL.md

For review freshness, join covered resources to data/content-review.json by catalog resource_id. Do not infer a later review date from sitemap lastmod, changelog activity, Git history, or a newer skill version.

Website/data/agent changelog entries are separate from mobile-app releases. Do not infer an Android/iOS app version from website changes.
